text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre...!
Please wait just a moment. I'll get painkillers right away...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Do not panic.
It is merely a headache.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh?!
T-The King is this infuriated...!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
I-I am so sorry!
It is entirely due to our utter incompetence...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
I place no blame upon you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enduring the severe headache, Orfevre ended up
intimidating everyone around her...
